mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_in(code, req_id, chemical_id, lot_no, qty, expiry_date, cabinet_id, supplier, permit_no, receiver_id, checker_id, status, in_time) VALUES(#{code}, #{reqId}, #{chemicalId}, #{lotNo}, #{qty}, #{expiryDate}, #{cabinetId}, #{supplier}, #{permitNo}, #{receiverId}, #{checkerId}, #{status}, #{inTime})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_in WHERE code LIKE CONCAT(#{dayPrefix}, '%')
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_in SET status = 1, checker_id = #{checkerId}, in_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE stock_in SET status = 1, checker_id = #{checkerId}, in_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE stock_in SET status = 2, reject_reason = #{reason} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) FROM stock_in WHERE req_id = #{reqId} AND status = 1
